text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her best efforts, Ines Fujin 
failed to achieve good results in the 
Tenno Sho (Spring), and let out all her 
frustration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Mejiro Ryan, who was also 
defeated, held back her frustration and 
spoke to her fans—words meant to inspire 
both herself and everyone watching.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that, Ines Fujin felt the gap 
between herself and Mejiro Ryan, and began 
to think about how she should face the 
cheering voices.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Can she become like Mejiro Ryan? To help 
her find that answer, let's build up her 
training for the Takarazuka Kinen!
